newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold firms slightly, volume steady.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold firms slightly, volume steady.

text.p: Traded volume on the Istanbul gold exchange edged higher to 842 kg on Wednesday from Tuesday's 815 kg in steady trade dominated by continuing physical demand from the free market, dealers said.
Gold closed at $348.80 an ounce and 1,361,000 lira per gram, up from $348.00 and 1,360,000 lira on Tuesday, in line with the world trends.
"There was physical demand from the free market which also played a role in firmer prices," one dealer said.
The Turkish lira firmed to 120,900 lira to the dollar from 121,100 lira on Tuesday, suppressing gold's lira value.
Most of the day's trade -- 527 kg -- was conducted in the morning session and 49.5 percent of total turnover was in lira terms.
